title: Indian construction has a robotics problem
brief: Indian construction still relies heavily on people to apply putty, sand walls, prime surfaces and paint them. This video follows the Centa Painter, a modular robot designed to automate those repetitive finishing jobs, then explains what robots can and cannot do on messy, changing construction sites. The engineering story is machine vision, navigation, interchangeable tools and consistent surface coverage—not a humanoid replacing every builder overnight.

topic_candidates.title: iPhone DUO Unboxing & Hinge Test
topic_candidates.query: Apple iPhone Duo precision hinge foldable display official specifications October 2026
topic_candidates.brief: The viral unboxing videos make the phone look simple: open it and get a tablet-sized screen. The real story is the hinge and the layers underneath it. The video explains how a foldable OLED, protective coating, precision hinge and two-part battery must work together while surviving thousands of bends, dust exposure and everyday drops. Viewers get a practical answer to the question: is a foldable phone genuinely durable, or merely expensive to repair?
topic_candidates.evidence_summary: Apple identifies the Duo as its first foldable iPhone and says it uses a precision hinge, a 7.6-inch inner OLED display, dual batteries and an IP68 rating. Those specifications establish the engineering design, but they do not prove long-term durability beyond Apple’s testing; independent drop and hinge tests should be treated separately.

topic_candidates.title: Elon Musk Sắp Cấy Chip Não Blindsight. AI này thật sự giúp người khiếm thị có thể nhìn thấy?
topic_candidates.query: Neuralink Blindsight FDA Breakthrough Device designation visual cortex stimulation official
topic_candidates.brief: The viral claim sounds like a person will suddenly see normal video through an AI chip. The video slows that down: Blindsight is intended to stimulate the visual cortex, where the brain processes vision, after cameras or sensors convert information into electrical patterns. It explains what a brain implant might create—simple flashes, shapes or low-resolution signals—and what has not yet been demonstrated in people.
topic_candidates.evidence_summary: Neuralink says Blindsight received FDA Breakthrough Device designation for people with vision impairment. Neuralink’s own clinical-trial page says its disclosed devices are investigational and not FDA-approved. Therefore, the evidence supports an experimental development program, not restored sight or a completed human demonstration.

topic_candidates.science_angle: Visual neuroprosthetics: cortical stimulation, neural coding, sensory substitution and the difference between generating phosphene-like signals and recreating natural vision.
